description:
Use only with the user's own likeness or content they are authorized to use. Do not use for impersonation, deception, sexual content, or content involving minors.

Replaces a subject in a video with a character from a reference image, or transfers the video's motion onto that character. Starts a background job that costs credits; returns a project id for wait_for_video_project. Before choosing settings, read get_account_info and the current parameter constraints. A listed model, resolution, duration or count is not necessarily available together or on this account. Preserve explicit requirements and all supplied inputs; explain a genuine block instead of submitting an incompatible request. Account balance alone does not prove a request is affordable. Use the named attachment fields first for ChatGPT files. Ask which file goes where if their roles are unclear. If a file fails, ask the user to attach it again and keep the requested settings.

assets.description: Source video and reference character image for the job.

image_file_path.description:
Reference character image used as the replacement or animation target. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

video_file_path.description:
Source video containing the subject to replace or animate. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

end_seconds.description:
End time of your clip (seconds). Must be greater than start_seconds.

Free plans are currently limited to 10 seconds of clip (`end_seconds` minus `start_seconds`), enforced by the API and may change. When the user gave no duration, choose one within it. Keep an explicitly requested longer one, explain the Free limit and ask before changing it. Do not default to the source video's full length.

model.description:
Model to use. Defaults to `wan-animate`.

* **`wan-animate`**: 480p, 720p. Supports `points` subject selection.
* **`kling-3.0`**: 720p, 1080p. Clips of 3–30 seconds in `animate` mode or 3–10 seconds in `replace` mode. Picks the main person automatically, so `points` are rejected.
* **`kling-4.0`**: 720p, 1080p. Clips of 3–30 seconds in `replace` mode. Picks the main person automatically, so `points` are rejected.
* **`minimax-h3`**: 480p, 720p, 1080p. Clips of 1–60 seconds in `animate` mode or 1–30 seconds in `replace` mode. Subject `points` are `replace`-only; `animate` with `selection_mode` `point` returns 422, and with `auto` or no `selection_mode` the points are ignored.

name.description: Optional project name for identifying this output. Omit to use the API's default project name.

resolution.description: Output video resolution. Must be supported by `model`. Defaults to the lowest resolution available on your plan for that model.

start_seconds.description: Start time of your clip (seconds). Must be ≥ 0.

style.description: Optional style controls for replace vs animate mode and subject selection.

mode.description: Processing mode. `replace` swaps the detected subject with your reference character. `animate` transfers motion from the video onto your character image.

points.description: On-frame markers for manual subject selection. Required when `selection_mode` is `point`. Ignored when `selection_mode` is `auto` or omitted. Rejected for models without subject selection (supported by `wan-animate`, `minimax-h3`). `minimax-h3` subject `points` are `replace`-only; `animate` with `selection_mode` `point` returns 422, and with `auto` or no `selection_mode` the points are ignored. MiniMax H3 manual replacement accepts 1 to 10 points; each must satisfy `start_seconds <= time_seconds < end_seconds`.

position_x.description: Horizontal pixel coordinate in the source video frame at `time_seconds`, measured from the left edge.

position_y.description: Vertical pixel coordinate in the source video frame at `time_seconds`, measured from the top edge.

time_seconds.description: Timestamp on the source video timeline in seconds. Uses the same clock as `start_seconds` and `end_seconds`. For MiniMax H3 manual replacement, `start_seconds <= time_seconds < end_seconds`.

prompt.description: Optional direction. Supported by kling-3.0, kling-4.0, minimax-h3. For MiniMax H3 in replace mode, ignored and not saved when `selection_mode` is `point`; applies only to automatic person selection.

selection_mode.description: How to locate the subject in the source video. `auto` detects a person automatically. `point` uses your `points` to mark the subject and is supported by `wan-animate`, `minimax-h3`. `minimax-h3` subject `points` are `replace`-only; `animate` with `selection_mode` `point` returns 422, and with `auto` or no `selection_mode` the points are ignored. Defaults to `auto`.

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the video. If the status is not 'complete', this value is an estimate and may be adjusted upon completion based on the actual FPS of the output video. 

If video generation fails, credits will be refunded, and this field will be updated to include the refund.
